source.evidence: Nine numbered chart cards visible in the post media; names and examples read from the image. Suitability rules below are our own interpretation.

charts.name: 파이 차트
charts.requires: one categorical dimension, one nonnegative additive measure, known whole
charts.bestFor: rough shares of 2–4 parts at one point
charts.avoid: many slices, negative values, exact ranking, incompatible denominators

charts.name: 도넛 차트
charts.requires: one categorical dimension, one nonnegative additive measure, known whole
charts.bestFor: rough shares of a few parts with an actual total in the center
charts.avoid: center value with a different denominator, many slices, precise comparison

charts.name: 퍼널 차트
charts.requires: ordered stages, same cohort and unit, nonincreasing counts
charts.bestFor: where the same cohort drops out across stages
charts.avoid: unrelated stage counts, cohorts with different definitions, increasing counts without explanation

charts.name: 와플 차트
charts.requires: one categorical dimension and known denominator; cells represent equal units
charts.bestFor: a coarse percentage out of 100 or another clear unit grid
charts.avoid: precision beyond cell resolution, many parts, unclear rounding

charts.name: 트리맵
charts.requires: nonnegative additive values; one-level parts or a valid hierarchy
charts.bestFor: many parts or nested groups where area represents size
charts.avoid: negative values, tiny unreadable leaves, precise close-value comparison

charts.name: 선버스트
charts.requires: rooted acyclic parent-child hierarchy with nonnegative additive leaf values
charts.bestFor: hierarchical composition across two or more levels
charts.avoid: cross-links, deep or dense labels, double-counted parent totals
charts.preferInstead: hierarchy-tree or treemap when labels and precise values lead

charts.name: 폭포 차트
charts.requires: starting value, ordered signed deltas, computed or supplied ending value
charts.bestFor: which increases and decreases explain a final value
charts.avoid: independent category values or unexplained final total mismatch

charts.name: 파레토 차트
charts.requires: one category, nonnegative additive measure, meaningful total; sort descending and calculate cumulative share
charts.bestFor: identify whether a few categories account for most of the total
charts.avoid: negative values, nonadditive rates, forced 80/20 conclusion
charts.preferInstead: bar-comparison if only ranking is needed

charts.name: 마리메코 차트
charts.requires: two categorical dimensions and nonnegative additive cell values; column width and segment height encode different shares
charts.bestFor: compare category-group size and each group's internal mix together
charts.avoid: negative values, missing/ambiguous cells, precise cell comparisons, too many categories
charts.preferInstead: stacked-categories plus totals for more exact reading
